# Ayan Chakraborty — Enterprise Data Architect & Consultant

> Official portfolio of Ayan Chakraborty, an independent Enterprise Data Architect & Consultant with 14+ years of experience building petabyte-scale data infrastructure for global enterprises. Top 3% expert on Toptal.

## About

Ayan Chakraborty is an Enterprise Data Architect and Consultant who designs, leads, and delivers mission-critical data systems for global enterprises. He works directly with companies — not through an agency. His core philosophy: precision architecture, enterprise impact, zero compromise.

- 14+ years of hands-on experience
- 100+ enterprise projects delivered
- Top 3% globally on Toptal
- Clients include: Cognizant, PepsiCo, IPG, Lotlinx, Acronym, Alef, Brightly, NetZoom, Nous, Shega, Solaris, Yara

## Core Expertise

- **Enterprise Data Architecture** — Designing scalable, secure, cost-effective data platforms for petabyte-scale workloads
- **Databricks** — Expert-level implementation, optimization, and governance
- **Snowflake** — Data warehousing, architecture, cost optimization
- **AWS & GCP** — Cloud-native data pipelines and infrastructure
- **AI & ML Implementation** — Production-ready AI pipeline development on top of robust data foundations
- **Data Security & Governance** — Compliance frameworks, security policies, enterprise data governance
- **Cloud Cost Optimization** — Reducing cloud spend on Databricks, Snowflake, and AWS environments
- **Corporate Training** — Upskilling engineering teams in data architecture and modern data stack

## Services

1. **Strategic Data Consulting** — Aligning data strategy with business goals; building long-term data roadmaps
2. **Scalable Data Architecture** — Designing data platforms built for performance, growth, and security
3. **Enterprise AI Implementation** — Deploying production-ready AI and ML pipelines
4. **Data Security & Governance** — Implementing compliance standards and governance frameworks
5. **Cost & Resource Optimization** — Cutting cloud overhead; maximizing ROI on data investments
6. **Corporate Data Training** — Mentorship and team upskilling across Databricks, Snowflake, and AWS

Ayan offers both **Fractional Data Architect** engagements (advisory) and **full end-to-end implementations** depending on client needs.

## Industries Served

Banking & Finance, Retail & E-commerce, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Manufacturing & Supply Chain, Technology & SaaS, Telecom & Media, Energy & Utilities, Education & EdTech

## Career Roadmap Approach

Ayan also shares a structured Data Engineering career roadmap — mapping the journey from College → Junior Data Engineer → Senior Data Engineer → Data Lead → Data Architect. This reflects his mentorship philosophy and educational content available on his YouTube channel.
